Peppered Honey Mustard
By: Leah Rodrigues
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 11:45pm

Ingredients




3/4 cup Dijon mustard
1/4 cup Honey
1 tablespoon Cracked pepper
1/8 teaspoon Salt
1 Tablespoon rice wine vinegar

Preparation

1 This mustard is excellent with chicken or mixed into a homemade vinaigrette salad dressing. 2 Combine all ingredients in a small serving bowl, stirring well. 3 Garnish, if desired. 4 Yield: 1 cup. "Southern Living", November, 1995.
